statement_en: There is no exact covering system - that is, a finite collection of congruence classes $a_i\pmod{n_i}$ with distinct $n_i$ such that every integer satisfies exactly one of these congruence classes.

namespace SimpleGraph
variable {V : Type*}
structure Cycle (G : SimpleGraph V) where
  
  base : V
  
  walk : G.Walk base base
  
  isCycle : walk.IsCycle
end SimpleGraph

namespace SimpleGraph
variable {V : Type*}
def Cycle.length {G : SimpleGraph V} (c : Cycle G) : ℕ := c.walk.length
end SimpleGraph

namespace SimpleGraph
variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
def havelHakimiStep (s : List ℕ) : List ℕ :=
  match s with
  | [] => []
  | d :: rest =>

    let (to_decrement, remaining) := rest.splitAt d

    let decremented := to_decrement.map (· - 1)

    (decremented ++ remaining).mergeSort (· ≥ ·)
end SimpleGraph

namespace SimpleGraph
variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
def residueAux : List ℕ → ℕ
  | [] => 0
  | 0 :: s => 1 + s.length
  | d :: rest => residueAux (havelHakimiStep (d :: rest))
end SimpleGraph

namespace SimpleGraph
variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
noncomputable def residue (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : ℕ :=

  residueAux ((Finset.univ.val.map fun v => G.degree v).sort (· ≥ ·))
end SimpleGraph

open Pointwise
structure CoveringSystem (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] where
  ι : Type
  [fintypeIndex : Fintype ι]
  residue : ι → R
  moduli : ι → Ideal R
  unionCovers : ⋃ i, ({residue i} : Set R) + (moduli i : Set R) = @Set.univ R
  ne_bot : ∀ i, moduli i ≠ ⊥
  ne_top : ∀ i, moduli i ≠ ⊤

open Pointwise
structure StrictCoveringSystem (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] extends CoveringSystem R where
  injective_moduli : moduli.Injective

open Function

theorem erdos_58572 :
